Experiment 1
Fill the burette with the solution C of potassium manganate(VII) to the 0.0 cm mark.
Using a measuring cylinder, pour 25 cm of solution D into the conical flask.
Add 1.0 cm of the solution C to the flask, with shaking. Continue to add solution C to the
flask until the mixture just turns permanently pink. Record the burette reading in the table
and complete the table.
Pour away the contents of the conical fl ask and rinse the fl ask with distilled water.

Experiment 3
To about 2 cm of solution E in a test-tube, add an equal volume of aqueous ammonia.
Shake the test-tube and note any observations. Leave the mixture to stand for 5 minutes
and note any changes.
